latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing by AI Online — Edit and Export Videos with AI.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for fast, automatic editing.
- Describe your desired edits (e.g., "cut pauses, add transitions") and receive finished MP4 clips in 1-2 minutes.
- Supports common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements within the same session.
- Automatically manages authentication and session setup; grants 100 credits for anonymous users.
- Exports in various formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, etc.), with clear feedback and error handling for common issues.
